title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada's covenant, the crowning of Joash, and the end of Athaliah.

questions.text: In which year did Jehoiada strengthen himself and make a covenant with the captains of hundreds?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 23:1 says that in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the captains of hundreds into a covenant with him.

questions.text: Whom did they gather out of all the cities of Judah?
questions.explanation: They gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers' households of Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

answers.text: The prophets and the priests of Baal
The merchants and craftsmen of the cities
The soldiers and captains of Israel's king
The Levites and the heads of fathers' households

questions.text: What did Jehoiada say must happen, as Yahweh had spoken concerning the sons of David?
questions.explanation: Jehoiada said, "Behold, the king's son must reign, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the sons of David."

answers.text: The priests must rule the land
Athaliah must reign until she dies
The people must choose a new king

questions.text: What did Jehoiada give to the captains of hundreds?
questions.explanation: Jehoiada gave the captains the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David's, which were in God's house.

answers.text: New swords and helmets made by the smiths of Judah
The bows and arrows of the king of Israel
The spears, bucklers and shields that had been king David's
Chariots and horses brought up from Egypt

questions.text: What did the people say after Jehoiada and his sons anointed the king?
questions.explanation: After they crowned and anointed him, they said, "Long live the king!"

questions.text: What did Athaliah say when she saw the king standing by his pillar?
questions.explanation: Athaliah tore her clothes and said, "Treason! treason!"
She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king's house, and they killed her there.

answers.text: Beside the altar inside Yahweh's house
At the entrance of the horse gate to the king's house
Before the altars in the house of Baal
At the gate of the foundation of the city

questions.text: Who was killed before the altars in the house of Baal?
questions.explanation: The people broke down the house of Baal and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

questions.text: Why did Jehoiada set gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: He set the gatekeepers so that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

answers.text: So that no one who was unclean in anything should enter
To collect money for the repairs of the house
To keep the Syrians out of the city at night
To announce the hours of prayer to the people

questions.text: Through which gate did they bring the king to the king's house?
questions.explanation: They came through the upper gate to the king's house and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.
